info.name: Roam API — Mock (no server needed)
info.description:
Every request has a saved example taken from the real backend.
1) Collection → ⋯ → Mock collection → Create Mock Server.
2) Copy the mock URL into the collection variable baseUrl.
3) Send any request — Postman's cloud returns the example, no local server required.
